record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.context_brief: CDH countable powers of zero-dimensional real subspaces
record.original_question: For zero-dimensional subsets X of the real line R, characterize when the countable power X^omega is countable dense homogeneous.

evidence.quote: Problem 4. For which 0-dimensional subsets X of R is Xω homogeneous? CDH?
The second part of the question is still being investigated though important partial results were obtained:

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A separable topological space Y is called countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if for any two countable dense subsets D, D' of Y there exists a homeomorphism h: Y → Y with h(D) = D'. A subspace X of the real line R is zero-dimensional if it is nonempty and has a base consisting of relatively clopen sets (equivalently, X embeds into the Cantor space). Endow the countable power X^ω with the product topology.

Problem: Give a characterization of those zero-dimensional subspaces X ⊆ R for which X^ω is countable dense homogeneous.
artifact.status_search_result: A full characterization is not known, but substantial partial results exist. For Borel subsets X of 2^ω, X^ω is CDH iff X is G_δ (iff X^ω is homeomorphic to 2^ω or ω^ω); for coanalytic X ⊆ 2^ω, CDH of X^ω is equivalent to X being Polish. Sufficient conditions (e.g., every countable subset of X lies in a Polish subspace, λ-set conditions) and consistency results (CDH sets of size ℵ1) are also known. The general (non-definable) case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Countable Dense Homogeneity in Powers of Zero-dimensional Definable Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: For a coanalytic X ⊆ 2^ω, CDH of X^ω is equivalent to X being Polish; classification of zero-dimensional Borel CDH spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial characterizations exist in the definable (Borel/coanalytic) case.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity and λ-sets
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions for X^ω to be CDH involving λ-set properties.
status_evidence.claim: Partial sufficient conditions for non-definable zero-dimensional X.

status_evidence.title: Countable dense homogeneity in large products of Polish spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigations into CDH of products of Polish spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The topic continues to be actively researched.
